paite: Huan huai thilte nung in hichi ahong hi a, Jezreel mi Naboth in Jezreel ah grephuan anei a, huai Samaria kumpipa Ahab inn kiang a om hi.
heading: Naboth Grephuan
english: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

paite: Ahab in Naboth kiang ah, "Ka inn kiang a om ahih ziak in antehlouhing huan ding in na grephuan hon pia in. Asik in grephuan hoihzaw ka hon pe ding. Ahihkei a na deih zawkleh lah adangka in ama'n hun ding ka hon pe ding," chi in agen hi.
english: Ahab spoke to Naboth, saying, “Give me your vineyard, that I may have it for a garden of herbs, because it is near my house; and I will give you for it a better vineyard than it. Or, if it seems good to you, I will give you its worth in money.”

paite: Naboth in Ahab kiang ah, "TOUPA'N ka pu ka pate gou nang ka hon piak ding aphal kei," achi hi.
english: Naboth said to Ahab, “May Yahweh forbid me, that I should give the inheritance of my fathers to you!”

paite: Jezreel mi Naboth in huchibang thu akiang a agen ziak in Ahab ngui leh lungkim loutak in a-inn ah alut hi; ka pu ka pate gou ka hon pe thei het kei ding, achi bikbek ngal a. Huchi in alupna ah alum a, khat lam anga a, an ane kei hi.
english: Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him, for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

paite: Huchi in azi Jezebel ava hoh a, akiang ah, "Bangchidan ahia na lungsim huchitak a alungkham a, an na nek louh?" achi hi.
english: But Jezebel his wife came to him, and said to him, “Why is your spirit so sad that you eat no bread?”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Naboth kiang ah, na grephuan hon leisak in, ahihkeileh na deih zawkleh asik in grephuan dang ka hon pe ding ka chi hi. Ama'n, ka grephuan zaw ka hon pe thei het kei ding, chi in ahon dawng a ahi," achi hi.
english: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’”

paite: Azi Jezebel in akiang ah, "Israel gam kumpipa na hi kei a hia? Thou inla, an ne inla, lungsim nuamtak in om in. Ke'n Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan ka hon pe ding," achi hi.
english: Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

paite: Huchi in Ahab min in laithonte agelh a, Ahab suainamna in suai anam a, Naboth invengte a-upate leh makaite kiang ah akhak hi.
english: So she wrote letters in Ahab’s name and sealed them with his seal, and sent the letters to the elders and to the nobles who were in his city, who lived with Naboth.

paite: Laithonte ah, "An ngolh na puang unla, mipi lak ah Naboth ma kaisak un.
english: She wrote in the letters, saying, “Proclaim a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

paite: Belial tate mi nih ama ah tusak unla, nang Pathian leh kumpipa na gensia hi, chi a amah hek ding mi ana bawl un. Huchi in amah pikhia unla, suang in ana denglum un," achi hi.
english: Set two men, wicked fellows, before him, and let them testify against him, saying, ‘You cursed God and the king!’ Then carry him out, and stone him to death.”

paite: Atenna khua a upate leh makaite'n Jezebel in akiang ua akhak laithon akigelh bang in ana hihta uhi.
english: The men of his city, even the elders and the nobles who lived in his city, did as Jezebel had instructed them in the letters which she had written and sent to them.

paite: An ngolh apuang ua, mipi lak ah Naboth a makaisak uhi.
english: They proclaimed a fast, and set Naboth on high among the people.

paite: Belial tate mi nih hong pai in ama ah ava tu ua; Belial tate'n mipite ma ah, Naboth in Pathian leh kumpipa agensia, chi in amah ahek uhi. Huchi in khua a pan apokhia ua, suang in adeng ua, asita hi.
english: The two men, the wicked fellows, came in and sat before him. The wicked fellows testified against him, even against Naboth, in the presence of the people, saying, “Naboth cursed God and the king!” Then they carried him out of the city and stoned him to death with stones.

paite: Jezebel kiang ah, "Naboth suang in adeng ua, asita," chih hilh ding in mi asawl uhi.
english: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned and is dead.”

paite: Jezebel in Naboth suang in adeng ua, asita chih azak in hichi ahong hi a, Jezebel in Ahab kiang ah, "Thou inla, Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan, ahon leisak phal louh neita aw le. Naboth adam nawnta kei, asita hi," achi hi.
english: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”

paite: Ahab in Naboth asita chih azak in hichi ahong hi a; Jezreel mi Naboth grephuan nei dia kuansuk ding in Abab athouta hi.
english: When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

paite: Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tung a:
heading: Ahab Tung A Pathian Vaihawmna
english: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

paite: "Thou inla, Samaria a om Israel kumpipa houpih ding in hohsuk in. Ngai in, Naboth grephuan ah a-om a, neih tum in huai ah ahohsuk hi.
english: “Arise, go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who dwells in Samaria. Behold, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, where he has gone down to take possession of it.

paite: Akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi: 'Na that a, na neihsak behlap lai maw? chi inla, akiang ah, TOUPA'N hichi in achi, ui in Naboth sisan aliahna mun mah ah nang sisan leng aliak ding uh' na chi ding," achi hi.
english: You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?”’ You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “In the place where dogs licked the blood of Naboth, dogs will lick your blood, even yours.”’”

paite: Ahab in Elijah kiang ah, "Na hong muta maw, ka melmapa?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Hon muta ka hi ve; TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih dia nang leh nang na kikhotkhiak tak ziak in.
english: Ahab said to Elijah, “Have you found me, my enemy?” He answered, “I have found you, because you have sold yourself to do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Ngai in na tung ah thil hoih lou ka tungsak dia, na suante ka lamang dia, Ahab a pan a ta pasal taphot Israel gam a mi zalen hi in zalen lou hitaleh ka satkhe ding.
english: Behold, I will bring evil on you, and will utterly sweep you away and will cut off from Ahab everyone who urinates against a wall, and him who is shut up and him who is left at large in Israel.

paite: Nang na hon hehsak ziak in leh Israelte thil na hihkhelhsak ziak in Nebat tapa Jeroboam inkote leh Ahijah tapa Baasha inkote bang mai in na inkote ka bawl ding," achi hi.
english: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah, for the provocation with which you have provoked me to anger, and have made Israel to sin.”

paite: Jezebel tungtang thu leng TOUPA'N agen a, "Jezebel khokulh chin ah uite'n ane ding uh.
english: Yahweh also spoke of Jezebel, saying, “The dogs will eat Jezebel by the rampart of Jezreel.

paite: Ahab inkote lak a mi khopi a si peuhmah uite'n ane ding ua; gam a si peuhmahte tung a leng vasate'n ane ding uh," achi hi.
english: The dogs will eat whoever dies of Ahab in the city; and the birds of the sky will eat whoever dies in the field.”

paite: Azi Jezebel tohthoh a TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou hih dia amah-le-amah kikhawngkhia Ahab bang mi kuamah a-om kei hi.
english: But there was no one like Ahab, who sold himself to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.

paite: TOUPA'N Israel suante ma a delhkhiaksa Amorte thilhih chiteng bang in milimte bia in thilkihhuaitak ahih hi.
english: He did very abominably in following idols, according to all that the Amorites did, whom Yahweh cast out before the children of Israel.

paite: Ahab in huai thu azak in hichi ahong hi a, apuan abotkek a, sai-ip puan asilh hi. An angawl a, sai-ip puan ah alum a, kidawmtak in apai hi.
english: When Ahab heard those words, he tore his clothes, put sackcloth on his body, fasted, lay in sackcloth, and went about despondently.

paite: TOUPA thu Tishbi mi Elijah kiang ah ahong tung hi.
english: Yahweh’s word came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

paite: "Ka ma a Ahab akiniamkhiakdan na mu hia? Akiniamkhiak ziak in adamsung in hiai thil hoih lou ka tungsak kei dia, atapa damsung in bel a-inkote tung ah hiai thil hoih lou ka tungsak ding," achi hi.
english: “See how Ahab humbles himself before me? Because he humbles himself before me, I will not bring the evil in his days; but I will bring the evil on his house in his son’s day.”
